title: Coordinatewise sum of mapped lists
statement: Let $l$ and $ts$ be finite lists, and let $f$ assign an integer to each pair consisting of an element of $ts$ and an element of $l$. Adding the lists obtained by mapping $f(t,\cdot)$ over $l$, coordinate by coordinate and starting with a zero list of length $|l|$, gives the list whose entry at $c\in l$ is $\sum_{t\in ts} f(t,c)$.
hypotheses_covered: A list $l$ of elements of a type $\alpha$
A list $ts$ of elements of a type $\beta$
